minimum_protocol.rule: Track endpoint/product validity, auth/entitlement, historical contract discovery, historical quote retrieval and account feasibility separately. Record rawHTTP/transport/schema/empty/pagecap/error statuses; do not collapse to market absence.

Freeze a small documentation-backed endpoint/metadata capability probe first; only if a valid historical quote path is demonstrated, freeze quote-cell selection and finite request/page budgets before reading point quotes. Unsupported routes or entitlement failures stop dependent analytics with all planned cells marked unavailable/not-tested, not zero.

Index every exchange session2026Jan2-Oct5, including early closes and DST. Monthly/stratified probing must mark unsampled days explicitly; it establishes only sampled-cell access, not whole-year completeness. Oct6/future dates are excluded unless separately frozen after completed-session check.

Use broad vendor underlying/contract inventory if supported, preserving active/inactive/expired status and default-filter semantics. If bounded sampling is needed, fix a deterministic sample from the broad declared directory and liquidity strata before option outcomes, plus separately-labelled liquid ETF/product controls. Do not use old8, stock1079, OR-ready or best-return subsets as the option strategy universe.

Explicitly query historical expiration ranges and supported status values, follow all pages to terminalnull, preserve truncated/incomplete and conflicting versions. A currently returned expiredcontract or guessed OCC symbol is not evidence of complete historically discoverable chain. Retain underlying/currency/strike/type/expiry/exercise/settlement/deliverable/multiplier as evidence fields; providerUUIDs remainprivate.

For selected cells choose expiry/type/strike from catalog and a prior known underlying reference with deterministic tiebreaks, never current option volume/OI/delta, later highs, cheapest successful quote or hindsight affordability. Metadata-known-now selection is a capability sample, not an executable historical strategy.

Use only latest RAW quote state t<=decision parsed in exact integer nanoseconds, full complete pagination, no future fill or valid-old fallback after invalid latest. Conflicting same-time states are ambiguous absent documented sequence. Record feed/source/exchange/condition and unknown states. Empty, invalid, withdrawn, crossed, stale or missing update semantics remain distinct.

Freeze age thresholds as diagnostics (e.g.1second primary and5second sensitivity) with quote source timestamp semantics disclosed; these are not client-receipt or latency proof. Option size units and conditions must be confirmed independently, not copied from equitySIP2025unit changes. Positive known size is displayed capacity only, never a guaranteed fill.

Use Decimal and verified contract premium multiplier/deliverable, whole nonnegative integer quantities, ask-based entry cost, actual supported fees and explicit exit fee reserve within500 settledcash; optional250 comparisons must be predeclared. Quote-only premium fit with unknown fees is a lower-bound diagnostic, not fully affordable certification. A fixed1dollar reserve is only a labelled sensitivity unless sourced.

Report bid/ask spread, percentage of ask and conditional same-point buyask/sellbid debit separately from actualPnL. Missing exits are unknown; never replace with tradebarhigh, midpoint, theoretical price, zero or intrinsic value to claim achievable closing proceeds.

Before any strategy/wealth model, verify product-specific lasttrade/exercise/AMPM/cashversusphysical settlement and broker cutoff. Longpremium affordability does not finance100share delivery. Spreads require contemporaneouslegs, contractspecification/ratio/budget and assignment handling; no theoretical fractional or unfunded legs.

Save all planned cells, observed failures and denominators, data/schema versions, exact requestchains, inputhashes and no-fill labels. Public derived metadata/hashes only, no raw feed corpus, account/order/activity identifiers or credentials. No wealth projection, restart injection or order in this feasibility stage.
